Replace.Text: Replaces the resource icons in the 3D map view with smaller versions.
Shows each unit's earned promotions as small icons on its flag.
Show helpful map overlays for the selected unit or city. Turn this on, then choose which overlays appear below.
Outlines a city's workable tiles in the City View, and a settler's prospective city, shading tiles that would overlap a neighboring city.
Outlines the aura range of a selected Great General or Great Admiral.
Highlights revealed artifact tiles while an Archaeologist is selected; sites already targeted by one of your Archaeologists use a different color.
Traces the selected unit's queued movement route, with its destination tile ringed.
Speeds up turns by skipping combat and movement animations. Turn this on, then choose when it applies below.
Disable animations for player turns during times of war.
Disable animations for player turns during times of peace.
Disable animations for AI-civ turns while at war with you. AI turns at peace are always quick (no longer a toggle).
Disable animations for barbarian turns. Barbarians are always at war, so these settings always apply.

Enables quick combat resolution in single player games. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Warning:[ENDCOLOR] Turning this on during gameplay will automatically disable [COLOR_CYAN]Quick Animations[ENDCOLOR]. You can re-enable it through [COLOR_CYAN]User Interface Options[ENDCOLOR] in the Diplo Corner dropdown menu.

Enables quick unit movement in single player games. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]Warning:[ENDCOLOR] Turning this on during gameplay will automatically disable [COLOR_CYAN]Quick Animations[ENDCOLOR]. You can re-enable it through [COLOR_CYAN]User Interface Options[ENDCOLOR] in the Diplo Corner dropdown menu.
Shows a button beside End Turn that switches Single Player Auto End Turn on and off with one click.
This button can be hidden through [COLOR_CYAN]User Interface Options[ENDCOLOR] in the Diplo Corner dropdown menu.
Orders the Buildings list of the city production menu cheapest first, by turns to complete when producing and by price when purchasing. When off, buildings are grouped by era.

Shift+click an item in the city production menu to hide it in that city only, for both producing and purchasing. Hidden items move to the Hidden section at the bottom of the list, where Shift+click shows them again. Each city keeps its own list in the save. When off, every item is shown and the lists are kept.
